segments.text: The office is still. The white pedestal drawers are closed. The black monitor stands upright behind the keyboard.
The third drawer of the white pedestal slides out about 28 centimetres by itself, revealing a single shiny red apple resting at its front.
The red apple rises straight up out of the open drawer by itself, past the desk edge, then floats across in front of the desk and hovers in the air in front of the monitor, above the chair back.
Time slows into smooth slow motion. The apple hangs in the air, aimed at the monitor.
In slow motion, the apple is thrown hard straight at the upper middle of the monitor screen, flying across the desk, and strikes the screen.
Still in slow motion: the impact rocks the monitor backward and it starts to tip back over its foot, while the apple drops away from the screen.
Time slows further until it stops completely: the monitor is leaning back about 35 degrees and the apple hangs in the air in front of its screen.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera rushes in close to the hanging apple and the tilted screen.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera drifts slowly past the apple, very close, with the tilted screen behind it.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera swings low around to the right of the monitor, banking into the turn, the apple and the leaning screen in the middle of the view.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera rises high and looks down on the frozen apple, the tilted monitor, the keyboard and the desk.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera pulls back and sweeps round to the left.

The entire world is frozen; only the camera moves. The black monitor hangs mid-fall, leaning back about 35 degrees on the edge of its round foot, and the red apple hangs motionless in the air just in front of its screen, about twenty centimetres above the desk to the right of the keyboard. Nothing else moves. The camera settles back into its earlier position, looking at the monitor and the desk.
Time starts again in slow motion: the monitor resumes tipping backward and the apple resumes dropping.

Still in slow motion: the monitor tips over its foot and slowly falls backward over the cable tray onto the far desk, landing on its back with the screen facing up. The apple drops onto the near desk to the right of the keyboard, bounces up about seven centimetres, bounces once more and rolls a short way to the right, then stops.
Playback returns to normal speed. The monitor settles on its back on the far desk; the apple rests on the near desk to the right of where the monitor stood.

At normal speed everything is at rest. The camera slowly moves to the right to reveal the toppled monitor lying screen-up across the far desk and the apple resting on the near desk; the third drawer stays open.
